\hypertarget{doc-terraform}{%
\chapter{\texorpdfstring{Terraform reference implementation (\texttt{terraform/})}{Terraform reference implementation (terraform/)}}\label{doc-terraform}}

Data-driven: governance lives in YAML, the HCL is generic. Tested offline with OpenTofu 1.10 and
provider 2.0.5 (\texttt{validate}, \texttt{test} with a mocked provider); the repository CI also runs HashiCorp
Terraform. Requires Terraform \textgreater= 1.7 or OpenTofu \textgreater= 1.8.

\texttt{tests/guard\_messages.sh} proves each negative fixture fails with the \textbf{intended} message
(\texttt{expect\_failures} alone only proves that \emph{some} guard failed).

\hypertarget{provider-facts-this-code-relies-on-verified-in-v205-sourceschema}{%
\section{Provider facts this code relies on (verified in v2.0.5 source/schema)}\label{provider-facts-this-code-relies-on-verified-in-v205-sourceschema}}

\begin{enumerate}
\def\labelenumi{\arabic{enumi}.}
\tightlist
\item
  \texttt{akeyless\_role.rules} is authoritative; there is no per-rule resource.
\item
  \texttt{assoc\_auth\_method} inside \texttt{akeyless\_role} is deprecated - associations are separate resources.
  The role only reads associations back when its own block is used, so there is no drift.
\item
  \texttt{name} is ForceNew on roles, auth methods, folders, issuers, keys, targets, static secrets;
  \texttt{role\_name}/\texttt{am\_name} on associations. Rename = destroy + create (new access ID for auth methods).
\item
  \texttt{delete\_protection}: string on auth methods/roles/folders/static secrets/certificates, bool on
  \texttt{akeyless\_pki\_cert\_issuer} and \texttt{akeyless\_dfc\_key}.
\item
  Not marked sensitive in the schema: \texttt{akeyless\_auth\_method\_oidc.client\_secret}, computed
  \texttt{akeyless\_auth\_method\_k8s.private\_key} - always feed through sensitive variables.
\item
  \texttt{jwt\_login.jwt} must be set in HCL (validation fails otherwise, despite the
  \texttt{AKEYLESS\_AUTH\_JWT} env fallback in the provider code).
\item
  Env fallbacks: \texttt{AKEYLESS\_GATEWAY}; without a login block \texttt{AKEYLESS\_ACCESS\_ID} + \texttt{AKEYLESS\_ACCESS\_KEY}.
\item
  Role names do not suppress leading-slash differences (auth methods and associations do).
\item
  \texttt{akeyless\_account\_settings} is partial and its destroy is a no-op.
\item
  \texttt{akeyless\_pki\_cert\_issuer.ttl} is a string in seconds; \texttt{key\_usage} default
  \texttt{DigitalSignature,KeyAgreement,KeyEncipherment}.
\item
  Import IDs: object name; associations \texttt{"\textless{}role\textgreater{}:\textless{}auth\ method\textgreater{}"} or \texttt{"\textless{}role\textgreater{}:\textless{}assoc\_id\textgreater{}"}.
\item
  Refreshing \texttt{akeyless\_static\_secret} reads the secret value (keep values out of this state).
\end{enumerate}
